items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was it different from the Joe Garber. [INTERVIEWER] Oh, yes, it was. Joe Garber didn't have a Dixieland. He played mostly stocks and arrangements.

ctx.x: Oh, he had a little Dixieland. About six, seven pieces.
Was it different from the Joe Garber.
Oh, yes, it was. Joe Garber didn't have a Dixieland. He played mostly stocks and arrangements.
